rows.grounds: Instrumental of a compound formed from aikya (oneness, unity) and bhāva (state, attitude); expresses the mode in which contemplation is performed.

items.question: What inner attitude sustains the proper contemplation of the unified self?
premises: The self is contemplated as unified with the splendor of the three.
This contemplation is to be performed properly.
The mode of contemplation is characterized by a state of oneness.
items.inference: Proper contemplation of the unified self is sustained by assuming an attitude of oneness.
